{{Quote|We have laws on how we treat sentient species. We have laws on how we treat animals and semi-sentients. We even have laws protecting plants. But we have absolutely no laws whatsoever governing the welfare of clone troops—human beings. They have no legal status, no rights, no freedoms, and no representation. Every one of you here who accepted this army without murmur should hang your head in shame. If that's the depths we as a Republic can sink to in the name of democracy, it hardly surprises me that the CIS wants to break away. The end can never justify means like this.|Den Skeenah, speaking before the Galactic Senate|<ref name="True Colors" />}}
'''Den Skeenah''' was [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] from [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|We understand. You talk to some malcontent like Senator Skeenah, he puts unhelpful ideas in your head about the direction of the war effort&mdash;|Arbian J. Lemmeloth to Besany Wennen|<ref name="order66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>}}
During the war, Den greatly disliked the fact that the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] had no rights, legal status, freedoms, or representation and believed all who accepted the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] without question should have felt shame. He was a man who believed the ends never justified the means and set up a charitable appeal to fund the only veterans' welfare facility for the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone soldiers]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. During the war, he was a known anti-war activist and met with [[Besany Wennen]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Skeenah was replaced by [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] after his death during the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation of the New Order]] under the rule of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].
